core_meaning.primary_meaning: Haimi is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “Life”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haimi corresponds to the Hebrew form None (Hebrew חַיִּים (Ḥayyīm) 'life'; diminutive/variant Haimi). Its core sense is life, living. Haimi is best explained as a form of the Hebrew name חַיִּים (Ḥayyīm / Chaim) 'life', cognate with Arabic حياة (ḥayāh). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the record's Arabic column gave أحمد ('Ahmad'), and the gloss 'fragrant' is unsupported. A separate tradition reports 'Haimi' as a Nepali name meaning 'golden'; that is a different, unrelated name. Because the dataset carries both Arabic and Hebrew in its language column, this is recorded as the Hebrew 'life' name at medium confidence.
